test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some Ants are Bats.

Some Bats are Cats.

**Conclusions: **

I. Some Ants are Cats.

II. All Bats can never be Cats.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e17576fc6f4dc3573645cd83c54ee83c1df0894a29813a76c0b9665d5e160814.png] 

Conclusions: 

I. Some Ants are Cats → False (As Some Ants are Bats and Some Bats are Cats so, Some Ants are Cats is false)

II. All Bats can never be Cats → False (As Some Bats are Cats so, All Bats can never be Cats is false)

∴ Here, Both conclusions I and II are false.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither conclusion I nor II follow".**
